title: Complete constant-image rank-six locus of the fixed-resolvent space
statement: Over every field, the rank-at-most-six locus of the fixed 112-dimensional limiting matrix space W is a 17-dimensional linear subspace. Every nonzero member has rank six and the same six-dimensional image. The mixed outer block locus has dimension five; its intersection with the pure Q space has dimension four. Twenty-six exact triangular seven-minor identities and a polynomial normal form certify the classification.
dependencies: AI-RESOLVENT-SHARP-MINRANK-001 source convention, full block decomposition and outer-source minimum rank, pinned in sources.json
Twenty-six integer triangular seven-minor identities with unit substitutions
limitations: Ordinary matrix rank in this fixed space only. No varying-resolvent classification, arbitrary singular-degeneration exclusion, independent review, formalization or exponent improvement.

title: Sharp dimension111 bound and complete rank109 compression incidence
statement: Over every field, for P of size110 by112 and C of size112 by110, both of rank109, the map X to PXC on the fixed space W has kernel dimension at most one and image dimension at least111. Every nonzero kernel is a unique projective polynomial tuple p of degree bounds(4,3,3,3), together with any three-plane L in the common six-dimensional image I; ker P=L and im C=X(p)^-1(L). Every such incidence is realizable, so dimension111 is sharp; dimension112 also occurs.
dependencies: Elementary leading-monomial proof of the component-pair polynomial product dimension inequality
limitations: Constant compression of the fixed W only. The result does not control new leading coefficients under varying singular compressions or prove a new matrix-target exclusion. Written and unreviewed; no formalization or exponent improvement.
